```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)

# Combine them into a single tidy tibble corpus
fta_corpus <- tibble(
  agreement = c("Kyrgyzstan", "CIS_2011", "FTA_1994", "Georgia", "Armenia", 
                "Montenegro", "Macedonia", "EU", "Israel", "UAE", "Canada", 
                "Moldova", "Azerbaijan", "Belarus", "Kazakhstan", "Tajikistan", 
                "Uzbekistan", "UK"),
  text = list(pdfkyrgyz, pdfCIS2011, pdfFTA1994, pdfGeorgia, pdfArmenia, 
              pdfMontenegro, pdfMacedonia, pdfEU, pdfIsrael, pdfUAE, pdfCanada, 
              pdfMoldova, pdfAzerbaijan, pdfBelarus, pdfKazakh, pdfTajik, 
              pdfUzbek, pdfUK)
)
```
```{r}
library(quanteda)
library(dplyr)

# Collapse each PDF's vector of pages into a single character string per agreement
fta_corpus_flat <- fta_corpus %>%
  mutate(text = sapply(text, paste, collapse = "\n"))

# Now create the corpus safely
my_corpus <- corpus(fta_corpus_flat, text_field = "text")

# Check it
summary(my_corpus)
```
